storage: Fridge at the coldest shelf and cook within a day, or freeze in flat portions (125 g, one serving) for up to about 2 months; thaw in the fridge, not on the counter.
looksLike: Pink-red ground meat with fine white flecks of fat, sold chilled in plastic tubs or trays.
howToPick: Bright pink-red colour, a fresh clean smell, little liquid in the tub and a cold pack. Avoid grey or brown mince, a sour smell or slime. Ask for mince made from boneless goat meat, as some shops add fat or mix meats, which is hard to check by eye.
shelfLife: Chilled fresh mince is a short-life product; use within 1 day of delivery or freeze (FitPlate dish 77 storage notes cover the cooked keema: 3 days fridge, 2 months freezer).

usedIn.raw: 125 g raw mince per serving (a heaped ½ cup, loosely packed)
